methodology: Each T02 debt item annotated with (1) remediation effort in hours, (2) business impact if fixed, (3) business risk if NOT fixed, (4) dependency ordering. Cost-benefit matrix ranks all items by ROI (impact-per-hour).

summary.criticalPath: DEBT-003 → DEBT-002 → DEBT-005 → DEBT-006 → DEBT-001 → DEBT-012

sprint1.focus: Foundation fixes — module resolution, CI accuracy, dependency hygiene

sprint2.focus: Quality gates — linting, coverage, type checking

sprint3.focus: Runtime safety — type casts, config flexibility, secret hygiene

sprint4.focus: Architecture — modular exports, scripts cleanup, test coverage

costBenefitMatrix.title: Missing type:module in package.json
costBenefitMatrix.rationale: Sub-hour fix that eliminates module resolution ambiguity across the entire codebase. Highest ROI item.

costBenefitMatrix.title: Adapter tests use wrong test runner
costBenefitMatrix.rationale: Sub-hour fix that eliminates false CI failures. Prevents developer habituation to ignoring test red.

costBenefitMatrix.title: All deps declared as devDeps including runtime
costBenefitMatrix.rationale: Sub-hour fix. Unblocks production dependency auditing and correct deployment installs.

costBenefitMatrix.title: No linting or formatting tool configured
costBenefitMatrix.rationale: Medium effort but high impact. Establishes automated quality gates. Reduces review burden. Blocks style drift.

costBenefitMatrix.title: Adapters directory excluded from type checking
costBenefitMatrix.rationale: Quick win that catches type errors in the GSD-Pi adapter bridge. Critical for automation reliability.

costBenefitMatrix.title: Minimal vitest configuration
costBenefitMatrix.rationale: Medium effort. Adds coverage thresholds and timeout configuration. Makes regression risk visible.

costBenefitMatrix.title: Unsafe as any casts in worker IPC
costBenefitMatrix.rationale: Medium effort. Eliminates 3 type safety gaps in the plugin entry point. Prevents runtime shape mismatches.

costBenefitMatrix.title: GITHUB_TOKEN accessed without validation
costBenefitMatrix.rationale: Quick-medium effort. Unifies secret access pattern. Enables future vault integration. Reduces audit surface.

costBenefitMatrix.title: Hardcoded circuit breaker polling config
costBenefitMatrix.rationale: Medium effort. Enables environment-specific tuning. Reduces wasted polling in dev, improves recovery in prod.

costBenefitMatrix.title: Scripts directory cluttered with artifacts
costBenefitMatrix.rationale: Low effort but low impact. Improves contributor onboarding. Non-blocking for functionality.

costBenefitMatrix.title: 7 source files have no test coverage
costBenefitMatrix.rationale: Highest effort item. High impact but low ROI due to volume. worker.ts and issueBlueprintFlow.ts are highest-priority targets.

costBenefitMatrix.title: Flat barrel index.ts re-exports 38 modules
costBenefitMatrix.rationale: Medium-high effort, low impact. Module boundaries are a future concern. No current consumer pain.

debtItems.title: Missing type:module in package.json
debtItems.effortBreakdown: Edit package.json: 5 min. Verify all scripts work: 15 min. Update documentation: 10 min.

businessImpactIfFixed.developerVelocity: Eliminates module resolution confusion. Scripts run correctly with Node.js.
businessImpactIfFixed.reliability: Consistent module behavior between TypeScript compilation and Node runtime.

debtItems.businessRiskIfNotFixed: Scripts that use import/export will fail when run directly. New contributors hit module errors. Build pipeline depends on esbuild handling the mismatch silently.

debtItems.title: Adapter tests use wrong test runner
debtItems.effortBreakdown: Add exclude pattern to vitest.config.ts: 5 min. Verify 64/64 suites pass: 10 min. Update CI config if needed: 5 min.

businessImpactIfFixed.developerVelocity: Eliminates false CI failure. Developers trust test results again.
businessImpactIfFixed.reliability: CI pipeline shows accurate pass/fail state.

debtItems.businessRiskIfNotFixed: Developers learn to ignore CI failures. Real regressions get masked by the known empty suite. CI becomes a rubber stamp.

debtItems.title: All deps declared as devDeps including runtime
debtItems.effortBreakdown: Move react to dependencies: 2 min. Verify npm install --production includes react: 10 min. Update docs: 5 min.

businessImpactIfFixed.developerVelocity: Production dependency audit works correctly. Deployment tooling installs all runtime deps.
businessImpactIfFixed.reliability: Deployments include all required runtime packages.
businessImpactIfFixed.security: npm audit --production scans react for vulnerabilities.

debtItems.businessRiskIfNotFixed: Production deployments that use --omit=dev will miss React. Security audits miss runtime dependency vulnerabilities.

debtItems.title: No linting or formatting tool configured
debtItems.effortBreakdown: Choose and install linter (ESLint/Biome): 30 min. Configure rules: 45 min. Add pre-commit hook: 30 min. Run initial fix: 30 min. Verify CI integration: 15 min.

businessImpactIfFixed.developerVelocity: Automated style enforcement. PRs focus on logic, not formatting. Consistent codebase.
businessImpactIfFixed.reliability: Catches common bugs (unused vars, unreachable code) before they ship.
businessImpactIfFixed.security: Lint rules can catch security anti-patterns.

debtItems.businessRiskIfNotFixed: Code style drifts. Review burden grows linearly with contributors. Common bugs slip through.

debtItems.title: Adapters directory excluded from type checking
debtItems.effortBreakdown: Update tsconfig include: 5 min. Fix resulting type errors: 45 min. Verify tsc passes: 15 min. Update CI: 5 min.

businessImpactIfFixed.developerVelocity: Type errors in adapters caught at compile time, not runtime.
businessImpactIfFixed.reliability: GSD-Pi adapter type safety. Runtime shape mismatches prevented.

debtItems.businessRiskIfNotFixed: Type errors in the adapter bridge go undetected. Runtime failures in Paperclip automation. Debugging requires reproducing live failures.

debtItems.title: Minimal vitest configuration
debtItems.effortBreakdown: Add coverage provider config: 20 min. Set thresholds: 15 min. Add timeout/retry: 10 min. Add include/exclude: 10 min. Verify full suite: 15 min.

businessImpactIfFixed.developerVelocity: Coverage thresholds prevent new untested code. Explicit timeouts prevent hanging tests.
businessImpactIfFixed.reliability: Regression risk is measurable. Flaky tests can be retried.
businessImpactIfFixed.security: Coverage metrics reveal untested security-sensitive code paths.

debtItems.businessRiskIfNotFixed: No coverage enforcement means test coverage degrades silently. Flaky tests block CI without retry. Test behavior changes across vitest versions.

debtItems.title: Unsafe as any casts in worker IPC
debtItems.effortBreakdown: Define return type interfaces: 45 min. Remove casts and add satisfies/annotations: 30 min. Verify tsc passes: 10 min. Add type-level tests: 30 min. Verify plugin loads: 15 min.

businessImpactIfFixed.developerVelocity: TypeScript catches API shape changes at compile time. Faster debugging.
businessImpactIfFixed.reliability: Worker IPC message handling is type-safe. API mismatches caught before runtime.

debtItems.businessRiskIfNotFixed: If Paperclip's tool registration API changes, the plugin fails at runtime with opaque errors. Debugging requires live reproduction.

debtItems.title: GITHUB_TOKEN accessed without validation
debtItems.effortBreakdown: Route direct env access through secretResolver: 30 min. Update externalIO.ts fallback paths: 30 min. Add tests for secret resolution: 15 min. Verify: 15 min.

businessImpactIfFixed.developerVelocity: Single secret access pattern. Easier to add vault/KMS integration later.
businessImpactIfFixed.reliability: Secret access is auditable. Missing tokens fail fast with clear errors.
businessImpactIfFixed.security: Unified secret resolution enables centralized rotation, access logging, and vault migration.

debtItems.businessRiskIfNotFixed: Two secret access patterns coexist. Future vault integration requires touching externalIO.ts. Audit cannot determine which code paths access secrets.

debtItems.title: Hardcoded circuit breaker polling config
debtItems.effortBreakdown: Add constructor parameter with defaults: 30 min. Add env var override support: 20 min. Update tests: 20 min. Document config: 10 min.

businessImpactIfFixed.developerVelocity: Environment-specific tuning. Dev can use longer intervals; prod can use shorter.
businessImpactIfFixed.reliability: Polling behavior adapts to deployment context. Backoff can be tuned per environment.

debtItems.businessRiskIfNotFixed: Dev environments waste resources on 30s polling. Production cannot tune recovery speed. All environments share one config.

debtItems.title: Scripts directory cluttered with artifacts
debtItems.effortBreakdown: Audit scripts/ directory: 20 min. Create archive structure: 10 min. Move milestone-specific scripts: 30 min. Update references: 15 min. Verify: 15 min.

businessImpactIfFixed.developerVelocity: New contributors can find reusable scripts. scripts/ becomes a curated toolkit.
businessImpactIfFixed.reliability: Milestone scripts cannot be accidentally run on wrong environments.
businessImpactIfFixed.security: Reduces attack surface by removing unused executable scripts.

debtItems.businessRiskIfNotFixed: scripts/ grows indefinitely. New contributors waste time sorting through one-off artifacts. No cleanup policy.

debtItems.title: 7 source files have no test coverage
debtItems.effortBreakdown: worker.ts integration tests: 8h. issueBlueprintFlow.ts unit tests: 6h. contracts.ts type tests: 2h. Other files indirect coverage review: 4h.

businessImpactIfFixed.developerVelocity: Regression confidence in core modules. Safer refactoring.
businessImpactIfFixed.reliability: Worker entry point and core business flow are tested. Breakage detected early.
businessImpactIfFixed.security: Security-sensitive code paths (secret handling, external IO) are verified.

debtItems.businessRiskIfNotFixed: Worker.ts breakage kills the entire plugin. issueBlueprintFlow.ts bugs affect core business logic. Refactoring is high-risk.

debtItems.title: Flat barrel index.ts re-exports 38 modules
debtItems.effortBreakdown: Design namespace structure: 1h. Group exports: 2h. Update consumers: 2h. Verify no breakage: 1h.

businessImpactIfFixed.developerVelocity: Clear module boundaries. Internal APIs are distinguishable from public.
businessImpactIfFixed.reliability: Better tree shaking. Internal changes less likely to break consumers.

debtItems.businessRiskIfNotFixed: No current pain. Future concern as codebase grows. All internal APIs are public by default.

parallelizable.note: All independent, can be done in parallel
DEBT-005 depends on DEBT-002 being done first
DEBT-012 depends on DEBT-001; DEBT-010 is independent
All independent, DEBT-011 needs DEBT-006 from sprint 2

fixNow.rationale: Sub-2-hour fixes that eliminate foundation-level problems. Zero risk, high reward.

fixThisSprint.rationale: Quality gates that prevent regression accumulation. High impact on developer velocity.

fixNextSprint.rationale: Runtime safety improvements. Medium urgency but high reliability impact.

backlog.rationale: High-effort items with lower ROI. DEBT-011 is the biggest investment; DEBT-007 is low priority.
